subject: Mathematics
title: Fiji Year 10 Mock Examination 3 — Mathematics
instructions:
Answer ALL questions. Time allowed: 2 hours (an extra 10 minutes is allowed for reading).
Multiple-choice: click the letter of the best answer (click again to clear).
Short answers and paragraphs: type your answer in English in the box. Show working for calculations.
Your answers are saved automatically. The paper is submitted automatically when time runs out.
You may use a calculator. Round answers to 2 decimal places unless stated otherwise.
Two questions ask you to draw on the Cartesian plane — use the graph tools (point, line, curve, shading).

A rectangular field is 40 m long and 30 m wide. Find the length of its diagonal.

A 5 m ladder leans against a vertical wall. The foot of the ladder is 1.5 m from the wall.
(a) Calculate the angle x that the ladder makes with the ground. (2 marks)
(b) Calculate the height h that the ladder reaches up the wall. (2 marks)
questions.model:
(a) The ladder is the hypotenuse (5), the ground is ADJACENT to x (1.5) → use cos.
cos x = 1.5 ÷ 5 = 0.3 (1) → x = cos⁻¹(0.3) = 72.54° (1)
(b) h² = 5² − 1.5² = 25 − 2.25 = 22.75 (1) → h = √22.75 = 4.77 m (1)

questions.text: From a point on level ground 20 m from the foot of a tree, the angle of elevation of the top of the tree is 35°. Calculate the height of the tree.
From the top of a cliff 60 m high, the angle of depression of a boat is 25°. Calculate the distance from the boat to the foot of the cliff.
questions.model:
The angle of elevation of the cliff top from the boat is also 25° (alternate angles) (1).
tan 25° = 60 ÷ d (1) → d = 60 ÷ tan 25° = 60 ÷ 0.4663 = 128.67 m (1)
